blocking_issues: A real-looking 32-char sk- API key was committed to config/app_config.json in 302077a (removed in d1d2958); both commits are on origin/master (public history). Rotate/revoke, purge history, add secret scanning to CI.

CI would fail at HEAD: `python -m evaluation.agent_eval.report --check` exits 1 because docs/agent-eval.md was not regenerated after 0970f9a made result commands repo-relative; and no commit on round2 has run in CI yet (push pending).
Final online numbers (held-out + test v2, DeepSeek + GLM, LLM-path red team on holdout2) are not yet at the round-2 commit; README/docs contain 'final2' placeholders.

Claim-check (the main differentiator) fails on the most common phrasings: 'PE'/'PB' after Chinese text is not recognised (claim_check.py:37-38) and comparators like 超过/高于/低于 are treated as equality, so '茅台ROE超过30%' (actual 33%) is 'contradicted' in API and UI.
English 'why' answers are wholesale lower-cased by the compliance guard (answer_guards.py:278-283), corrupting names and turning citation ids into invalid chips in the UI.

Multi-turn/dangling handling broke on unseen questions (~25% errors on the deterministic path): '为什么会这样' follow-up and fresh '这两家哪个更值得关注' refused as out-of-scope; 'And the P/B?' answered with macro data; '这两家' after a 换成 chain lost an entity; wrong-period/missing-metric questions answered silently.
Verification repair emits garbled mid-sentence fragments (verifier.py:306-316) on the ~21% of agent answers that fail first verification.
Agent-path latency still 20-66 s (P95 42-66 s in committed load tests, first token 13.9 s in my run) and not re-measured after the deadline change.
